scope: CPU FP32, one intra/inter-op thread, frozen validation system traces; no scientific test evaluation

gate_d.interpretation: observed repeated software-in-the-loop workload only, not statistical significance or Jetson performance

component_comparison.instrumentation: component times reported separately from durable-event full pipeline; no direct superiority claim across scopes

safety: precheck free memory before each level; skip this and higher levels on memory infeasibility or observed OOM; preserve failures
